title: Four-device IBM OM ideal baseline selection
hypothesis: A baseline shared within each destination-column pair, or enforced exactly by a partner intrinsic-reference cell, will make logical zero physically faithful and recover ideal bounded continuous initialization accuracy relative to independent per-cell RESET means, while a single quad-wide baseline will reveal the tradeoff between exact zero contrast and equal zero-state destination loading.
motivation: Earlier ideal screens confounded baseline choice with heterogeneous intrinsic references, level spacing, level count, or unmatched calibration. This study isolates the baseline decision before training by applying every full conductance as G=B+d, selecting each policy on the same development assignment with continuous bounded targets, and retaining the frozen four-delta map only as a quantization diagnostic.

arms.description: Matched control with one bounded eight-read RESET-mean baseline per physical cell.
One exact bound-feasible maximum commissioned RESET baseline shared by all four cells in each quad.
Separate exact bound-feasible maximum commissioned RESET baselines for (G++,G-+) and (G+-,G--).
Four-cell sign-selected active/reference encoding whose active baseline exactly equals the partner intrinsic reference in each destination column.

completion_criteria: All twelve declared native validate runs complete from the frozen ReLU source SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52, repeat development assignment 86001, and evaluate exactly one of held-out assignments 87001-87003 on all 10000 test examples.
Every production config resolves runtime.device=cuda, and the formal launcher records a successful CUDA availability and GPU-identity probe before creating any native task.

At each assignment seed, every policy uses the same jointly repaired four-cell hardware identities and the same commissioned RESET observations; semantic population, donor-selection, commissioning, source, topology, solver, and data fingerprints match across arms.

Every physical target is finite and nonnegative, every programmed active target is within its sampled bounds, every saved mapping satisfies G=B+d exactly, and full G enters both signed transfer and conductance-sum loading.

Shared-quad, shared-destination-column, and reference-enforced policies satisfy their declared exact zero-contrast gate within 1e-9 of the four-delta spacing; donor exhaustion, incomplete coverage, or a failed physical invariant invalidates the assignment rather than silently clipping it.

Continuous bounded mapping alone selects each policy's development scale pair and positive logit gain. The four-delta mapping reuses those frozen values without refitting and cannot select the preferred baseline.
Optimizer updates, BPTT, QAT, program-and-verify, target write noise, inference read noise, retention, drift, and post-deployment recovery are exactly absent.

The initialization gate passes only if the preferred policy reaches at least 90 percent mean held-out continuous accuracy. A unique winner is declared only if it has strictly more continuous correct predictions than every other arm on all three paired held-out assignments and leads the runner-up mean by at least 1.00 percentage point; otherwise the comparison is inconclusive.
analysis_plan: Verify all source/config hashes, exact run coverage, development calibration receipts, joint-assignment and commissioning semantic fingerprints, full-G mapping hashes, prediction hashes, exact counts, and result bindings before comparing policies.

For each layer and assignment, report baseline contrast, total zero loading, destination-column loading imbalance, active-pair headroom, continuous and four-delta capacity, donor replacements, bound support, sign errors, voltage statistics, and the all-d-equals-zero circuit residual.

Reconstruct effective weight only from the full four-conductance contrast. Fit one positive zero-intercept analysis scale per layer and policy on development continuous targets, freeze it on held-out assignments, and report baseline, envelope, quantization, and total error components in normalized and ReLU-weight units.

Report exact correct/10000, accuracy, teacher agreement, KL, and paired prediction flips for continuous and frozen four-delta mappings on every held-out assignment. Preserve layers separately and summarize paired means plus the full three-assignment range without treating it as a confidence interval.

Rank valid policies using continuous held-out accuracy only, apply the predeclared unique-winner and 90-percent gates, and treat four-delta accuracy as a diagnostic of level-spacing loss rather than evidence about baseline quality.

Interpret shared-quad versus destination-column results jointly with zero-state destination loading and headroom. Do not attribute any gap to training, stochastic programming, fabricated-device conductance, or on-chip recovery because those interventions are outside this study.
